name: @proton1917/dsh-harness-plugins-workspace
description: Workspace for independently installable DeepSeek Harness plugins

scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build
scripts.pack:check: pnpm --filter @proton1917/dsh-live-stats pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @proton1917/dsh-web-background pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @proton1917/dsh-brand-mascot pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @proton1917/dsh-medical pack --dry-run
scripts.pack:release: pnpm --filter @proton1917/dsh-live-stats pack --pack-destination ./dist && pnpm --filter @proton1917/dsh-web-background pack --pack-destination ./dist && pnpm --filter @proton1917/dsh-brand-mascot pack --pack-destination ./dist && pnpm --filter @proton1917/dsh-medical pack --pack-destination ./dist
